$comment: Ground truth for the review skill's Tier-3 detection eval (scripts/skill-detection-eval.ts). Each fixture carries exactly ONE defect drawn from a rule this repo actually enforces. `fixture` is the file as committed here; `file` is where the runner plants it inside a disposable worktree, which is the path the review skill is expected to cite. `line` is the offending line IN THE FIXTURE, and copying is verbatim, so it is also the line in the planted file — which is why this directory is excluded from prettier: a reflow would silently invalidate every number below.

defects.rule: CLAUDE.md invariant #4 / docs/rules/security.md - Validate every boundary
defects.description: Server action writes client-supplied `plan` and `seats` to the database with no zod schema and no safeParse. Authorization and scoping are correct, so only the missing validation is wrong.
Internal navigation via a raw `<a href="/dashboard/billing">` instead of `<Link>` from next/link — a full document load that discards client-side routing.
A `fetch()` to an entitlements endpoint inside src/middleware.ts adds a per-request network round trip to every matched route. Middleware must stay a local JWT check.
The test calls `safeCallbackUrl()` and asserts nothing. It passes with the function returning an open-redirect target, and would still pass if the function were stubbed out.
Cross-feature deep import: `billing` imports `@/features/profile/profile-form` instead of going through profile's public `index.ts`.
